report.summary: The three‑drone swarm launched at 18:02:20 on 2026‑10‑02 and surveyed the full 30 × 90 m area, dividing it into eight lanes per band. All drones completed their eight assigned lanes, verified their tracks (VERIFY PASS) and returned home, landing with 50 % battery remaining. The mission detected all eleven unique person hazards, with final confidence values ranging from 0.86 to 0.92, matching the ground‑truth map within the 5 m radius. No false positives or missed targets were recorded. One duplicate detection was suppressed when drone 0 observed a person already logged by drone 1 (d1‑1).
